data.value: Showing environments for your devices only, click to show all environments

data.name: ToolTip_GpuLayers
data.value: Number of model layers placed on the GPU, -1 for all layers. Lower values move the remaining layers to system memory.

data.value: CPU threads used for layers in system memory, 0 for the default.

data.name: ToolTip_ContextSize
data.value: Tokens reserved for the conversation and the reply, larger values use more memory.

data.name: ToolTip_CacheOffload
data.value: Keep the conversation (key/value) cache in GPU memory

data.name: ToolTip_BackendReady
data.value: The backend environment is installed and ready to use.

data.value: Supported on this device but not installed yet, install it from Manage Environments or the first time you load a model that uses it.

data.name: ToolTip_BackendUnsupported
data.value: This backend is not available for this device.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_StableDiffusionCpp_High
data.value: Keeps all weights on the GPU.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_StableDiffusionCpp_Medium
data.value: Offloads the weights to CPU memory and moves them to the GPU when needed.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_StableDiffusionCpp_Low
data.value: Offloads the diffusion weights to CPU memory and the VAE, text encoders and other parts to disk, loading them when needed.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_StableDiffusionCpp_Balanced
data.value: Auto-fit: places the weights automatically to fit the available VRAM.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_AudioCpp_High
data.value: Keeps the whole model loaded on the GPU.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_AudioCpp_Medium
data.value: Enables the memory saver to reduce VRAM use.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_AudioCpp_Low
data.value: Enables the memory saver to reduce VRAM use.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_AudioCpp_Balanced
data.value: Enables the memory saver to reduce VRAM use.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_LlamaCpp_High
data.value: Runs all layers on the GPU and keeps the KV cache on the GPU.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_LlamaCpp_Medium
data.value: Runs all layers on the GPU and keeps the KV cache in CPU memory. Saves VRAM on long contexts.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_LlamaCpp_Low
data.value: Runs all layers on the CPU and keeps the KV cache in CPU memory. Slowest.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_LlamaCpp_Balanced
data.value: Uses the GPU Layers and Cache Offload values from the execution options.

data.name: ToolTip_MemoryMode_OnnxRuntime
data.value: OnnxRuntime manages its own memory, this setting has no effect.

data.name: ToolTip_WeightType
data.value: Converts the model weights to this type when loading. Smaller types use less memory but load slower and lose some quality. Default keeps the model's own type.

data.name: ToolTip_ResetExecutionOptions
data.value: Resets all options to their defaults. Save to apply.

data.name: ToolTip_EnvironmentSetupDontAskAgain
data.value: Stop asking to install missing environments on startup. Required updates are still shown.

data.name: ToolTip_UpscaleSeed
data.value: Seed for the video upscaler noise

data.name: ToolTip_UpscaleTemporalChunkSize
data.value: Number of frames processed per chunk, lower values use less memory

data.name: ToolTip_UpscaleTileSize
data.value: Tile size in pixels, smaller tiles use less memory, 0 uses the default

data.name: ToolTip_UpscaleWindowSize
data.value: Spacing of the reference frames, a window of 16 uses frames 0, 15, 30 and so on, the last frame is always included

data.name: ToolTip_GuidanceImage
data.value: Image guidance scale for edit and reference images, 0 uses the model default

data.name: ToolTip_ShiftedTimestep
data.value: Shifted timestep used by distilled timestep models, 0 disables it

data.name: ToolTip_Sigmas
data.value: Custom sigma schedule, a comma separated descending list ending in 0, for example 14.61, 7.8, 3.5, 0. Replaces the scheduler and the step count

data.name: ToolTip_SkipLayers
data.value: Skip layer guidance, a comma separated list of layers such as 7, 8, 9, applied between the start and end fraction of the steps. A scale of 0 disables it

data.name: ToolTip_SamplerArgs
data.value: Extra sampler arguments passed to stable-diffusion.cpp as key=value pairs

data.name: ToolTip_ClipSkip
data.value: Number of final CLIP text encoder layers to skip, 0 uses the model default

data.name: ToolTip_MoeBoundary
data.value: Point between 0 and 1 where sampling switches from the high noise model to the low noise model, 0 uses the default of 0.875

data.name: ToolTip_FrameChunk
data.value: Generate long videos in chunks, each continuing from the last frame of the one before. The length is no longer limited to a single pass, smaller chunks use less memory

data.name: ToolTip_SeamlessTiling
data.value: Wraps the image around the edge so the result tiles seamlessly in that direction

data.name: ToolTip_LiveStart
data.value: Transcribe the microphone live, the text appears while you speak.

data.name: ToolTip_LiveStop
data.value: Stop listening and complete the transcript.

data.name: ToolTip_FirstRunModelFolder
data.value: Models are downloaded to a Models folder in the location you choose, pick a drive with plenty of free space.

data.name: ToolTip_ModelSearchFolders
data.value: Use model files that other applications such as ComfyUI already have, without copying or downloading them again.

data.name: ToolTip_SelectAudioRange
data.value: Select the range of the source audio to regenerate

data.name: ToolTip_TrackName
data.value: The track the task works on, e.g. vocals, guitar, drums, bass or piano

data.name: ToolTip_CacheMode

data.name: ToolTip_CacheThreshold
data.value: How much change is allowed before a step is computed again, higher is faster but lowers quality, 0 uses the default

data.name: ToolTip_CacheWarmupSteps
data.value: Steps that always run before caching starts, 0 uses the default

data.name: ToolTip_CacheRange
data.value: The part of the sampling steps where caching is allowed

data.name: ToolTip_QueueAll
data.value: Queues every model in the list that is not installed

data.name: ToolTip_RescanModels
data.value: Looks for model files again, after you have copied files into the model or search folders yourself.
